items.name: dhis2-value-display
items.title: DHIS2 Value Display
items.description: Read-only formatting of DHIS2 values by value type, option set and system calendar, keeping the day a date was stored on.
items.docs: Call formatDhis2Value(value, { valueType, optionSet }, { calendar, locale }) to get display text. Read the system calendar from useConfig().systemInfo, whose app-runtime type leaves out calendar: parseDhis2Calendar(z.object({ calendar: z.string().optional() }).safeParse(systemInfo).data?.calendar). Calendars other than Gregorian and ISO 8601 show as YYYY-MM-DD in that calendar.
